newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shell confirms cat cracker down for extended repair.
newsitem.headline: Shell confirms cat cracker down for extended repair.

text.p: One of two catalytic crackers at Shell's 374,000 barrel a day Pernis refinery in Rotterdam will be down for "a few months", a Shell spokesman confirmed on Friday.
"It is down. We are evaluating the problems and will carry out a maintenance shutdown which was planned at a later stage," he said.
"We expect it to last a few months," he said, declining to elaborate further.
The catalytic cracker, one of two at the Pernis site, went into an unscheduled stoppage on Thursday.
A Shell trader said it would lead to a reduction of gasoline output of 100,000 tonnes per month (28,000 barrels per day) for the next three months.
